intent: Show static text, optionally with a small icon, inside an InputGroupAddon.
typical_uses: A fixed prefix or suffix (a currency sign, a domain, a unit)
A static status next to the field (a character count)

dont_use_when.situation: An action the user clicks inside the addon

invariants.text: InputGroupText renders a plain span with no role, taking the addon's muted color and Label metrics; any svg inside it is sized to the small icon box and takes no pointer events.

anti_patterns.dont: Put an interactive control inside InputGroupText
anti_patterns.do_instead: Put an InputGroupButton directly in the addon; the text part is static content only

bad.title: Text part placed straight in the group
bad.why: The inset, order and click-to-focus belong to InputGroupAddon; a text part outside one gets none of them. Wrap it in an addon.
